result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but the promotional banner has a significant readability problem. Some horizontally scrolling content is partially cropped, though this may be intentional carousel behavior.

issues.description: The white headline and supporting text in the pale mint promotional banner have very low contrast and are difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use substantially darker text or a darker banner background, ensuring text meets WCAG contrast requirements.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and restaurant card are cut off at the screen edge. While this can indicate horizontal scrolling, the clipping looks abrupt and truncates the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent trailing padding and a clearer carousel affordance, or snap cards so the visible content does not appear accidentally cropped.
